sources.title: Predictive coding in the visual cortex: a functional interpretation of some extra-classical receptive-field effects
sources.notes: Foundational paper establishing feedback=predictions, feedforward=errors paradigm. Trained on natural images, produces V1-like receptive fields and predicts surround suppression.

sources.title: The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory?
sources.notes: Proposes variational free energy minimization as unified brain principle covering perception, action, and learning. Connects to Bayesian inference and active inference.
sources.role_in_article: theoretical framework extension, Friston free energy principle

sources.title: Predictive coding under the free-energy principle
sources.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
sources.notes: Hierarchical generative models; brain models causal structures; perception as model inversion. Uses birdsong simulation.

sources.authors: Bastos AM, Usrey WM, Adams RA, Mangun GR, Fries P, Friston KJ
sources.title: Canonical microcircuits for predictive coding
sources.notes: Maps predictive coding to cortical layer structure: L2/3=error units (gamma, feedforward), L5/6=prediction units (alpha/beta, feedback). Explains direction of oscillatory signals.

sources.authors: Keller GB, Bonhoeffer T, Hübener M
sources.title: Sensorimotor mismatch signals in primary visual cortex of the behaving mouse
sources.notes: Two-photon imaging, head-fixed mice on treadmill with VR. L2/3 neurons respond to visual-locomotion mismatch but not to visual or locomotion alone. V1 computes sensorimotor prediction errors.
sources.role_in_article: key empirical evidence for prediction error neurons in V1

sources.authors: Richter D, Ekman M, de Lange FP
sources.title: Suppressed Sensory Response to Predictable Object Stimuli throughout the Ventral Visual Stream
sources.notes: fMRI in humans, repetition suppression paradigm. Expected stimuli show reduced BOLD throughout ventral visual stream V1→IT. Consistent with prediction error minimization but confounded by neural adaptation.

sources.authors: Solomon SS, Tang H, Sussman E, Kohn A
sources.title: Limited Evidence for Sensory Prediction Error Responses in Visual Cortex of Macaques and Humans
sources.notes: Critical review questioning quality of predictive coding evidence in visual cortex. Many 'prediction error' signals cannot be distinguished from neural adaptation. Argues for more rigorous experimental designs.

sources.title: An Approximation of the Error Backpropagation Algorithm in a Predictive Coding Network with Local Hebbian Synaptic Plasticity
sources.notes: Mathematical proof that predictive coding with local Hebbian rules converges to backpropagation under specific conditions. Two neuron types: representation units and error units. Key limitation: requires one-to-one connectivity and near-zero error activity.
sources.role_in_article: key bridge between predictive coding and backpropagation, AI comparison

sources.title: Predictive Processing: A Canonical Cortical Computation
sources.notes: Review: predictive processing as canonical computation. Positive and negative prediction error neurons, SST+ interneurons in L2/3 compute errors. Evidence from mouse V1 locomotion experiments. Differences from backpropagation.

sources.title: A tutorial on the free-energy framework for modelling perception and learning
sources.notes: Most accessible mathematical treatment of predictive coding / free energy framework. Explicit differential equations for error units and representation units. Used for mathematical framework section.

sources.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
sources.notes: arXiv paper establishing VAEs. ELBO objective mathematically equivalent to variational free energy minimization in Friston framework. Core reference for brain-AI comparison.
sources.role_in_article: VAE framework, mathematical correspondence with predictive coding

notes_on_coverage: Rao & Ballard 1999 is not in PMC; full text not available. Friston 2010 NRN is also not PMC-open. Bastos 2012 Neuron and Keller 2012 Neuron not PMC-open. Whittington & Bogacz 2017 and Keller & Mrsic-Flogel 2018 are PMC-open and were read in full. VAE paper available on arXiv (open). Total: 3 open full text read (2 PMC + 1 arXiv), 7 abstract-only.
